nlohmann/json 3.11.3 single-header attributions

The amalgamated header carries Copyright (c) 2013-2023 Niels Lohmann.
Its UTF-8 decoder carries Copyright (c) 2008-2009 Björn Hoehrmann.
Its Grisu2 implementation carries Copyright (c) 2009 Florian Loitsch.
These notices accompany the MIT permission text in LICENSE.MIT.

The upstream release also identifies Hedley by Evan Nemerson (CC0-1.0) and
an Apache-2.0 Google Abseil fallback for builds without C++14. The Windows
GUI and QA harness are configured to build as C++17.

Upstream release and source attribution:
https://github.com/nlohmann/json/releases/tag/v3.11.3
